items.title: Add required @changes field to branding smoke task annotation
items.context: Validator reports packages/main/src/tasks/cli-engine-branding-smoke.ts:2 missing required field @changes. Add a concise changes summary without changing smoke behavior.
items.userSees: Terminal output includes "PASSED: All task annotations are valid." from node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-validate.js.

happy.desc: After adding @changes, the dist annotation validator accepts all task annotations and prints the exact PASSED line.

edge.desc: The source validator also accepts the same @changes metadata, proving the fix is in source and not only generated dist.

adversarial.desc: convergence_check no longer reports the previous missing @changes annotation error for cli-engine-branding-smoke.ts.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-validate.js
verificationEvidence.note: Build completed and dist validator printed PASSED: All task annotations are valid, covering the user-facing acceptance transcript.
Source validator scanned 406 files, found 60 tasks, reported 0 errors and printed PASSED: All task annotations are valid, proving the source @changes metadata is valid.

convergence_check reports Code annotations compliant=true with detail All 60 annotations compliant; remaining converged=false items are unrelated high-priority gap and unfinished stories B-92f6/B-a94f/B-c3b0, not the previous missing @changes annotation error.

auditLog.reason: Begin DEV work on the missing @changes annotation metadata.
Annotation metadata fix committed and validators confirm the missing @changes error is gone.
